caption:
Borrowed until Friday

Keep it as long as you like, the lender says. She names Friday, and the day sits on the lid.

Naming the day costs one word, and the lender stops wondering when it comes back.

For whoever says the day they will bring it back when they borrow something.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a blue-lidded container on the floor between two block figures with white eyes, one ink-black on the right and one royal blue on the left. The royal blue one says keep it. no rush. The ink-black one answers back on friday. A yellow tag that says Fri pops onto the lid and the container hops across to the ink-black one with its tag. The royal blue one says ok. friday! and both turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, naming the day.
